ES Tucson Fm=H petrol rows with Ep 132 kW: Va F5P41 (M 1639; Ve A61B13 127 g/km, A61B14 130-131, A61E24 131), Va F5P44 (M 1709, 145 g/km), and Va F5P31/F5P34 (M 1538/1633, 152/162 g/km). All HEV Ep-132 F5P41 rows are TAN E5*2018/858*00001*06, T NX4E. No field links a row to trim 'Tecno'.

separate_technical_variants: Va F5P44 (M 1709, 145 g/km; same value as IDAE Style 4x4 145) is presumably the AWD/HTRAC HEV - do not merge with FWD F5P41 (AWD attribution is by value, not officially decoded).

Within F5P41, Ve A61B13 (127 g/km), A61B14 (130-131) and A61E24 (131) are distinct versions; Tecno cannot be assigned to one by CO2 similarity (Maxx 127 vs Tecno 130 vs Style/N Line 131 are value matches only).

Va F5P31 / F5P34 (Ep 132, Fm H, M 1538/1633, 152/162 g/km) are presumably the 1.6 T-GDI 48V mild hybrid (DT) versions - different powertrain; F5P21 (Ep 110) and diesel F5D51/F5D54 (Ep 100) are 48V MHEV versions too.
Rows with TAN extensions *03/*04/*05 in early 2023 are older TAN revisions; do not merge with *06 without evidence.
